_comment: Limits for scripts/perf-gate on the Fire TV Stick 4K (release build, dev-mode on, nothing else running). Tighten as the app improves; loosen only with a reason in the commit.
_why: 2026-10-12 (P122): jank is judged as deadline-missed frames, not gfxinfo's janky %, which also counts on-time frames of the Top Shelf's autoplay as high input latency. 2 % = 1 frame in 50; measured on master: dock 1.3-1.6 %, grid 0.2-1.1 %. p90 is reported, not judged.
